fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 gives no explicit polynomial-size binary or integer matrix. Plücker valuations and the product formula do not by themselves convert a nonlinear valuation defect into syndrome weight or lattice coefficient norm; retaining sufficiently high compounds risks exponential size, while circuit linearization re-enters O2/O5.

Proposal 2 is the only proposal plausibly outside the phase obstruction, but it specifies neither canonical voltages nor a formula-to-action matrix, universal YES section, or polynomial-time binary compilation. Searching multiple small groups and actions post hoc is not a frozen experiment, and a finite pass would not test the required scaling law.

Proposal 3 is already killed by rank subadditivity and the certified affine-closure obstruction. If three legal shifted matrices have rank at most r and their XOR is an illegal cover, that illegal shifted matrix has rank at most 3r, precluding polynomial separation when r is constant.

Proposal 4 assumes a splitter isolates witnesses, but perfect hashing isolates elements of a fixed set, not one satisfying cover from all competing covers. Constructing protected centers or branches can require enumerating witnesses, while no selector matrix or all-mixed-sector soundness statement is supplied.

Proposal 5's product P(x) is nonlinear in the selected columns; a regular-representation block for the labels does not linearly compute that product. Exact realization requires high-degree monomial coordinates, an exponential free algebra, or a multiplication tableau already blocked by O2/O5.

Proposal 6 likewise lacks a constructible linear lift: evaluating global defects on every fiber point and spanning the lifts can be exponential or NP-hard. Expander propagation cannot help when an illegal affine mixed word annihilates the defect vector, and no theorem excludes that cancellation.

Proposal 7's traces, characteristic coefficients, and resolvent moments are nonlinear functions of x, not syndrome columns. Low moments fall under O1; full spectral linearization recreates the exponential determinant/exterior dictionary, while succinct circuits re-enter O2/O5.

Proposal 8 cannot preserve nonlinear Dehn area through a linear lattice realization: filling chains add, so an illegal odd XOR of three cheap legal fillings remains cheap. Retaining genuinely nonabelian filling area leaves O8 unresolved because no exact binary-syndrome or Euclidean-CVP encoding is given.
evidence: verify_exchange_quotient.py found 32 instances where an illegal odd cover lies in the affine span of legal matchings, including weight 5 versus legal weight 3. This directly kills the proposed rank shell and any linear classifier identifying or cheaply representing those witnesses.

verify_determinant_permutation_dictionary.py found support-three virtual permutation states even with all compound states, while the explicit monomial dictionary has factorial size. This is direct adverse evidence for proposals 1 and 7.

verify_nonbacktracking_schur_walks.py showed that even a concrete global nonlinear lift can have complete all-eight and odd-holonomy shell cancellation. Its generator also required exhaustive fiber enumeration, illustrating the unresolved construction defect in proposals 5 and 6.
The exact syndrome-to-CVP theorem only transfers an already explicit binary H,t instance. It supplies no compiler for valuations, products, spectral invariants, nonabelian transport, or filling area.

No verifier evidence is supplied for any of these eight proposals; every proposed experiment still requires inventing essential matrices, parameter bounds, or encodings. Consequently none is presently a genuinely bounded test of a fully specified candidate.
next_experiment: None for these formulations. Reopen only after a mutation supplies one frozen polynomial-time matrix family, explicit YES baseline and output rank, and an exact all-mixed-word test on all-eight, affine-closure, and odd-holonomy instances; the nonabelian voltage route would additionally need a fixed formula-to-voltage rule and binary compilation before testing.
